texts.preamble: Vikas Bamniya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2026 Author: Pranay Verma Bench: Pranay Verma Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Ind:4818 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Indore Before Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pranay Verma On The 17 th Of February, 2026 Writ Petition No. 5479 of 2026 Vikas Bamniya Versus The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others Appearance: Shri Ashutosh Sharma - Advocate for the petitioner. Ms. Pranjali Yajurvedi - Govt. Advocate for the responde Order
texts.arguments: (V) Any other relief considered just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case." 02. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the respondents are duty bound to complete the construction of MR-5 Road (Chhota Bangarda Road) which is about 100 feet only. It is submitted that the respondents are not doing the same without any rhyme or reason. Learned counsel for the respondents/State submits that the dispute is inter se the Municipal Corporation and the Indore Development Authority and it is for them to take appropriate action in the matter.
